title: Detecting Historical Turning Points in Italian Media: A Complex Systems Approach to a Diachronic News Corpus
abstract: arXiv:2606.14348v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Introduction: The increasing availability of large-scale textual corpora has opened new possibilities for data-driven, quantitative approaches to historical analysis using Natural Language Processing (NLP). However, diachronic corpora with historical relevance from the pre-digital era remain scarce and often incomplete.   Methods: We present a quantitative approach to historical analysis based on the reconstruction and exploration of a diachronic corpus of around 600,000 articles from the Italian newspaper "La Repubblica", covering all the articles published from the first of January 1985 to the 31st of December 2000 - a period of major political, social, and geopolitical change in Italy and globally. Using NLP techniques, we analyze the text at both lexical and semantic levels; we then apply tools from complex systems and statistical physics to trace shifts in media discourse over time.   Results: The word usage in the corpus

translated_title: 检测意大利媒体中的历史转折点：一种基于复杂系统的历时性新闻语料库分析方法
translated_abstract: 引言：大规模文本语料库的日益可得性，为利用自然语言处理（NLP）开展数据驱动的定量历史分析开辟了新的可能性。然而，来自前数字时代且具有历史意义的历时性语料库仍然稀缺且往往不完整。方法：我们提出了一种定量历史分析方法，该方法基于对意大利报纸《共和报》（La Repubblica）约60万篇文章构成的历时性语料库的重建与探索，涵盖1985年1月1日至2000年12月31日期间发表的所有文章——这是意大利乃至全球在政治、社会和地缘政治方面发生重大变革的时期。我们使用NLP技术在词汇和语义两个层面对文本进行分析，随后运用复杂系统和统计物理学的工具来追踪媒体话语随时间的演变。结果：语料库中的词汇使用（摘要在此处不完整）
tldr: 该研究构建了意大利《共和报》1985-2000年间约60万篇文章的历时性新闻语料库，结合自然语言处理与复杂系统、统计物理学方法，在词汇和语义层面定量检测媒体话语中的历史转折点。
en_tdlr: This study reconstructs a diachronic corpus of ~600,000 articles from the Italian newspaper "La Repubblica" (1985-2000) and combines NLP with complex systems and statistical physics methods to quantitatively detect historical turning points in media discourse at both lexical and semantic levels.
